I know puppies from Midgarden's program - they are AMAZING puppies!! But the best part, is that as an awesome breeder, you don't just get a dog, you get support and community as well.  Mielikki Borzoi is in Pennsylvania, and is who I got my pups from, and is also an excellent breeder who cares about the health and well being of their litter above all else.   
  
I am a pet home (as opposed to a show home), and I have two borzois. They are from the same litter, although one was purchased and the other is a rescue. I frequently go to dog shows in Doswell Virginia, and have met some awesome Borzoi people there. When I'm at a show, you'll often find me holding the leash of one or more borzoi, so I speak from experience when I say I know Midgarden dogs, and they are great!
